mentions.name: Eyes Off
mentions.description: A FOSS privacy app for macOS that watches for shoulder surfers: it uses the webcam with a locally running facial detection model and alerts the user when someone is detected in frame. Available at eyesoff.app.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A privacy app for macOS which tells you when someone is looking at your screen.

It uses the webcam and a locally running facial detection model to alert you if it detects someone in frame.

It's FOSS and available @ https://www.eyesoff.app
